settings.title: Settings
settings.modeHint: Switch between Dark Mode (default) and Light Mode.
settings.themeHint: Choose from 5 syntax-inspired color palettes (Monokai is default).
settings.densityHint: Comfortable shows thumbnails and two-line titles; Compact shows single-line titles without thumbnails.
settings.inboxLimitHint: Maximum number of unread news or videos shown in the inbox table (default: 100).
settings.completedDaysHint: How many days completed videos and articles stay visible in the right column (default: 7 days, max: 30 days).
settings.pollIntervalHint: How often TallyDeck automatically checks subscribed channels and feeds for new items in the background.
settings.twitchPollIntervalHint: How often TallyDeck checks the live status of your Twitch channels in the background (min. 15 min).
settings.autoArchiveHint: Automatically archive unread items older than X days so your inbox stays clean (newer items stay in your inbox; archived items do not count toward watched/read stats).
settings.autoArchiveToggle: Automatically archive unread items older than
settings.backupHint: Export or restore a complete TallyDeck snapshot including all channels, feeds, topics, read/watched history, weekly statistics, and settings.
settings.backupRestored: Backup restored: {feeds} feeds and {items} items imported.
settings.opmlHint: Import or export your subscribed YouTube channels and RSS feeds as standard OPML 2.0 files (including topic folders).
settings.twitchBackupHint: Export your saved Twitch channels as JSON or import a JSON or plain text file (one channel name or URL per line).

manage.noTopics: No topics yet. Create one above or assign a topic to any feed.
manage.confirmDeleteTopic: Delete topic "{name}"? Assigned feeds will be kept without a topic.
